name: Engagement staffing plan
summary: When several engagements want the same people, the resource lead sees the collision before kickoff: role needs against free days, leave and competing assignments, week by week, with two or three staffing options. The resource lead and partners choose.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of professional-services work, and its own rules for prepared work: the supplied records as the only authority, every gap written as a question, and people who choose and approve.
